label: PriceWaiting
summary: Users postpone purchases awaiting price drops or sales, citing high cost as a barrier.

quotes.text: Saved twenty items for the next End of Season Sale. That is what the wishlist is for.
Wishlisted a jacket that feels overpriced. Fit is fine, I am just not paying this much right now.
Not worth it at current MRP. I saved it and I will wait for price, even if I already know my size.

actionableInsight: Introduce in‑app price‑history visualizations and alerts to help users decide when to buy.

label: StyleUncertainty
summary: Users add items but remain unsure about occasion fit or styling, delaying purchase.

quotes.text: I like this dress but I do not know what occasion I would wear it to. Wedding guest? Office party? It is stuck on my wishlist.
Need styling help. The festive set is pretty but I cannot figure out what to pair it with, so I just keep it saved.
Wishlisted a formal shirt for a first day at work and still unsure if the occasion fit is right.

actionableInsight: Provide occasion‑based styling guides and virtual try‑on suggestions within the wishlist.

label: CompareDifficulty
summary: Users struggle to differentiate similar items, leading to indecision and wishlist stagnation.

quotes.text: I have eight similar white sneakers on my wishlist and I cannot decide which one to buy. Compare pages do not help.
Too many kurta options saved. Every time I try to decide between them I add another similar one instead.
Which one should I pick from these three wishlisted dresses? They all look the same in photos.

actionableInsight: Implement side‑by‑side comparison cards with key attributes and user ratings.

label: WishlistAsSaleWaitlist
summary: Users postpone because the current price feels too high, independent of fit.

quotes.text: My Myntra wishlist is basically my EOSS shopping list. I save everything now and wait for the sale to actually buy.
I will buy this jacket from my wishlist during BFF. No point paying full price when the sale is around the corner.
Saved twenty items for the next End of Season Sale. That is what the wishlist is for.
Not worth it at current MRP. I saved it and I will wait for price, even if I already know my size.

actionableInsight: Segment sale-waiters separately; do not use discounts as the intervention — quantify how often price timing exceeds 30 days.

label: StylingOccasionMismatch
summary: Users like an item but are unsure when to wear it or what to pair it with.

quotes.text: I like this dress but I do not know what occasion I would wear it to. Wedding guest? Office party? It is stuck on my wishlist.
Wishlisted a formal shirt for a first day at work and still unsure if the occasion fit is right.

actionableInsight: Surface occasion fit and pairing notes from reviews so users can decide if the save matches a real event.

label: ComparisonParalysis
summary: Users save many similar items and cannot narrow to one choice.

quotes.text: I have eight similar white sneakers on my wishlist and I cannot decide which one to buy. Compare pages do not help.
I forgot half the things on my wishlist. There are too many items and I never look back at the old ones.
In the interview I said I wishlist similar kurtas because I cannot compare fit. This must not count in Phase 1 frequency.

actionableInsight: Help users compare 2–3 same-category wishlist items on fit and review themes instead of adding more alternatives.

label: BookmarkVsIntent
summary: Some saves are bookmarks or later-maybe items, not active purchase intent.

quotes.text: I just saved it for later as a bookmark. I do not actually plan to buy this month, it is more of a moodboard.
Half my wishlist is maybe-later inspiration. Only a few items are real purchase intent.
I keep tapping save on trends I might like later. It is not a shortlist I will checkout from.

actionableInsight: Separate bookmark language from still-planning-to-buy language so W2P is not diluted by low-intent saves.

label: SocialValidation
summary: Users wait for a friend or partner to approve occasion or high-ticket wear.

quotes.text: Asked my partner for an opinion on the blazer I saved to my wishlist. Still waiting, so it sits there.
I wishlisted this lehenga but will not buy it until I share it on WhatsApp and my friend says it looks good on me.
Need a second opinion from a friend before I order the ethnic set I saved. Occasion wear is a big decision.

actionableInsight: Offer in-app social-proof synthesis so users need fewer off-app approval loops before deciding.

label: ReviewTrustGap
summary: Users leave Myntra to check YouTube or Instagram try-ons before buying.

quotes.text: I leave the app and search reviews on YouTube every time I am close to buying from my wishlist.
I always check YouTube try-on hauls before buying anything I wishlisted on Myntra. In-app reviews feel too generic.
Checked Instagram try on videos for the same dress I saved. Still not confident from the product page reviews.

actionableInsight: Bring synthesized try-on and review evidence into the wishlist so users do not have to leave the app.

label: WishlistDecay
summary: Large wishlists lose salience; users forget what they saved.

quotes.text: I forgot half the things on my wishlist. There are too many items and I never look back at the old ones.
My wishlist is clutter now. I open it, scroll, and close it without deciding.
The old wishlist items just sit there. I forget why I saved them until a sale notification shows up.

actionableInsight: Prioritize a small cluster of still-relevant items so revisit leads to a decision, not another scroll.

label: FitSizeAnxiety
summary: Users stall on wishlisted items because they cannot tell if the size will fit.

quotes.text: Loved this kurta set enough to wishlist it, but I still cannot tell if the size will fit me. The size chart and reviews contradict each other.
I keep opening the size chart for the same dress on my wishlist. Reviews say it runs small and I am scared to order the wrong size.

from the last 1 month the service and product are getting worst in myntra.they send wrong size or damaged product and they hold the return pick up. they are showing nonsense. makeup products are always damaged I got. no return and exchange properly. don't buy from Myntra this is

actionableInsight: Synthesize size and body-type review patterns so shoppers can resolve fit doubt without leaving the wishlist.

label: ReturnFearDelay
summary: Easy returns lower risk but users still delay ordering from the wishlist.

quotes.text: I tell myself I can always return it, so I delay ordering from the wishlist. Try and buy is my backup plan.
Return policy is great and I still hesitate. I would rather wait than deal with another exchange.

actionableInsight: Use return-reason patterns to raise pre-purchase confidence so try-and-buy is not the only decision strategy.
